note: StableFeeGateway (contracts/src/fees/StableFeeGateway.sol): accepts tUSDC/tUSDT for the token/NFT launch fee and routes 100% of it to the public PPL buyback recipient; the bought-back PPL is then split 30/25/20/10/15 by the treasury multisig off-chain (docs/design/buyback.md §4, §8). Owner-approved pricing (Alex, 2026-10-12): 5.00 USD for a token launch, 10.00 USD for an NFT mint — the UI reads the live fee from the gateway, not from this file. Stablecoin payment works on the People network only for now; cross-chain (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, TON, Solana) comes later. Empty address means the stable-fee option is hidden on /create/token and /create/nft.
